content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Research Scientist I and 1 for Junior Research Fellow.

content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I: MBBS/ BDS/ BHMS/ BUMS/ BAMS OR Master's Degree in Epidemiology / Public Health / Community Medicine Junior Research Fellow: Master's Degree in Public Health / Life Sciences / Clinical Research / Social Sciences / Epidemiology

content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I: Rs. 73000 Per Month Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 48000 Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist – I / Junior Research Fellow posts is 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Research Scientist – I / Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Research Scientist – I and Junior Research Fellow positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include MBBS/BDS/BHMS/BUMS/BAMS or a Master's Degree in relevant fields like Epidemiology, Public Health, Life Sciences, etc., depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 48000 to Rs. 73000 per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates must apply through the official website before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, which will provide all detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: These positions are contractual in nature, as indicated in the job type details for this recruitment drive.
